response.sql: SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_total_cost * 1.0 / derived_product_cost) AS avg_total_to_product_cost_ratio, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number ORDER BY line_item_count DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The ratio is computed per line item (derived_total_cost / derived_product_cost) and then averaged, rather than dividing sum of totals by sum of product costs.
Line items are the rows in Invoice_Line_Items; invoices with no line items are excluded.
Ties in line item count are broken arbitrarily, so the top 10 may not be deterministic if there are ties at the cutoff.
Line items with a zero derived_product_cost would cause a division error or NULL in some databases; none are specially handled (NULL results are ignored by AVG in SQLite).

alternatives.interpretation: Ratio of aggregates: total of derived_total_cost divided by total of derived_product_cost per invoice, instead of the average of per-line ratios.
alternatives.sql: SELECT invoice_number, SUM(derived_total_cost) * 1.0 / SUM(derived_product_cost) AS total_to_product_cost_ratio, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number ORDER BY line_item_count DESC LIMIT 10;
